verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed flight to orbit the Moon since Apollo 17.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'around the Moon...lunar flyby phase, when the crew travels on a free-return trajectory around the Moon, which allows the spacecraft to loop around the Moon and return to Earth without entering lunar orbit'; R3: 'circumnavigate the moon and will not land...pathfinder mission'; R4: 'first time since 1972 during Apollo 17, human beings have left Earth orbit'; R9: 'around the far side of the Moon...fly 4,600 miles beyond the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Artemis II is a flyby/free-return trajectory, not entering lunar orbit; Apollo 17 did orbit the Moon.
